title: Product change draft frontmatter
description: A lightweight drafting aid for a proposed product change. Not a normative model artifact: it lives under docs/product/changes/ while work is in flight, deleted or archived when the PR merges. No overlay, no promotion, no lifecycle states beyond draft/done.

status.description: draft while the change is in flight; done when the PR is ready to merge.

affected-artifacts.description: Artifact IDs this change intends to add, modify or remove. Informational: not validated as an overlay.
